title: Corpus manifest input (CORPUS_MANIFEST_INPUT/V1)
description: The input contract for a corpus Ben approves before any deal in it may be admitted. This is NOT the corpus manifest inside a released package (that is deal-terms-package.schema.json#/$defs/corpusManifest, where every member is already admitted and no field is nullable). This record is the proposal: it names the deals by SEC identity and records, per deal, whether admission has happened and what receipt proves it. Approval is a separate record, $defs/approval, which names this one by content ID; the two are not mutually referential. Every ID is contentId(domain, record) or sha256Hex(bytes) as defined in the producer's lib/canonical-v2/canonical-bytes.js.

corpus_manifest_input_id.description: contentId('CORPUS_MANIFEST_INPUT/V1', this record without corpus_manifest_input_id). The manifest is immutable: any edit is a new manifest with a new ID.

supersedes_corpus_manifest_input_id.description: The manifest this one replaces, or null for the first. A superseded manifest stays resolvable; it is never edited.

members.description: Ordered by deal_key, no duplicate deal_key.

hex64.description: A 64-character lowercase hexadecimal digest: sha256Hex(bytes) or contentId(domain, record).

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, zero-padded to ten digits.

admissionState.description: PROPOSED: named by Ben, not yet admitted. ADMITTED: an admission receipt exists and the canonical text is bound. REJECTED: admission was attempted and failed. WITHDRAWN: Ben removed the deal before admission.

source_admission_manifest_id.description: The content ID of the SOURCE_ADMISSION_MANIFEST/V2 record produced by lib/canonical-v2/sec-source-admission.js.

admission_receipt_id.description: The content ID of the SOURCE_ADMISSION_PREPARATION_RECEIPT/V1 record.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the receipt's committed bytes. Content ID proves what the record says; this proves which bytes said it.

deal_key.description: contentId('DEAL_TERMS_DEAL_KEY/V1', {source_system, issuer_cik, accession, document_role_key}). Known at proposal time; it does not depend on admission.

admitted_source_receipt.description: Null until the deal is admitted.

canonical_text_sha256.description: Null until the deal is admitted; the SHA-256 of the admitted canonical text thereafter.

agreement_id.description: Null until the deal is admitted; the producer's canonical-text content ID thereafter.

admission_reason_code.description: Required for REJECTED and WITHDRAWN, null otherwise.

approval.$comment: CORPUS_MANIFEST_APPROVAL/V1: a separate record naming the manifest by content ID. It follows the shape of DOCUMENT_ROLE_REGISTRY_AUTHORITY/V1 in lib/canonical-v2/deal-source-binding.js, where the authority record references the registry and carries ben_approval_id, rather than the registry carrying its own approval.

corpus_manifest_input_id.description: The exact manifest approved. Approval never carries over to a superseding manifest.

corpus_manifest_input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the approved manifest's committed bytes.

ben_approval_id.description: The content ID of Ben's approval record. A legal or corpus-composition ruling is Ben's alone; no agent may synthesise one.
